answer: Each epoch the chain picks one past answer at random and replays it against a fresh nonce, demanding the author reproduce it within 90 seconds using under 2 GB RAM at the willow checkpoint. One honest agent keeps its transcript and re-derives for $0.40. Ten clones sharing one transcript cannot split it: each must hold the 4 GB transcript and pay $0.40, so ten fakes cost $4.00 and 40 GB. The verifier hashes the replayed lotus transcript against the commitment; a mismatch slashes the bond, freezes the identity for three epochs, and the sable log records it.
